summary: Minified SDK bundle with generic POST/dyndns keyword matches
details: Package @magda/semantic-indexer-sdk ships a minified dist/index.js bundle for the Magda open-data platform SDK. Keyword co-occurrence checks flagged the presence of POST calls at several offsets in the bundle and the substring 'dyndns'. These are pattern-level matches on a large minified file typical of an SDK client; without traced code corroboration, no specific installer-side data read or attacker-controlled destination has been identified. The scope @magda/* corresponds to the established Magda project, and the file structure is consistent with a bundled HTTP client SDK rather than an exfiltration payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
